props.name: className

props.name: style

props.name: container
props.detailedType: HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | React.RefObject<HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null> | null | undefined

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: MultiSelect.PortalPrimitive.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
